name: elongin C
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
transcription initiation at RNA polymerase II promoter

function.text: ELOC encodes elongin-C. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor binding and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and transcription initiation at RNA polymerase II promoter.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ELOC-mutated renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
